name: Speed Reading Fundamentals
equipment: A book and a quiet space
instructions: Time yourself reading one page at your normal pace to get a baseline words-per-minute you can track improvement against.
Practice reducing "subvocalizing" (silently saying each word in your head) -- it is one of the biggest natural speed limits.
Use your finger or a pen to guide your eyes down the page slightly faster than feels comfortable; your eyes tend to follow the pacer.
Watch today's video for the full introduction to speed reading.
